title: Zoi full-platform production delivery
target: Deliver the entire requested Zoi and BuyGreek platform live in production by the revised 7:31 a.m. Eastern deadline, including full site-wide brand, UI, UX, logic, information architecture, formatting, navigation and promotion overhaul; working mobile app; all 30 benchmark capability areas; global Greek community; business AI and website integrations; creator monetisation; real marketplace operations; profession-specific tools; and Ownr.co-style company administration and supported formation/filing workflows.
estimate_note: This records the requested target, not a guarantee of complete delivery or external approvals.

requirements: One coherent brand and shared visual language across all public and authenticated routes
Redesign page hierarchy, navigation, formatting, promotion and content organization
Repair logic and interactions throughout real user journeys
Consistent typography, color, spacing, forms, controls and responsive states
Audit and replace simulated native operations
Shared Zoi brand across mobile and web
Verified device testing and distribution status
Release through available authorized distribution channels; report external signing/review blockers honestly
Resolve hosting pause within authorized spending
Restaurant menus, ordering, reservations and loyalty
Stylist appointments, deposits and client history
Professional and lawyer intake, matters, documents and deadlines
Church parish communications, calendars, giving, volunteers and events
Retailer stock, sales and wholesale workflows
Guided business formation via supported providers
No simulated success or invented statistics

scope.area: Ticketing, seating and immersive venue experience
requirements: Functional venue and seating editor backed by a shared layout model
Accurate accessible 2D seat selection and meaningful 3D venue preview
Real seat availability, expiring inventory holds and atomic reservations
Ticket issuance, organizer operations and check-in
Transparent payment and refund state backed by provider receipts
Equivalent appropriate web, iOS and Android journeys
Polished transitions, clear hierarchy, fast interaction and complete loading/error/empty states

completion_rule: An item is delivered only with implementation evidence, applicable passing tests, production verification and explicit limitations. Never equate a mockup, disabled control, schema alone, or local test with production completion.
execution: Parallel specialists with primary-agent integration; preserve pre-existing uncommitted work.
external_dependencies: Social platform review and API permissions
Jurisdiction-specific filing providers and qualified document review
goal_service_note: Attempt to replace the active tool goal was rejected because the thread has an unfinished goal. Available goal update tool supports status only. This file records the user-expanded objective governing execution; do not mark the old goal complete to bypass that restriction.

platform_release_rule.requirement: Every feature shipped on the site must have appropriate working iOS and Android capabilities. Track parity continuously, not only at initial launch.
evidence_per_feature: Loading, offline, retry and error states
platform_release_rule.honesty: Website link-outs, web exports and mocks do not establish native feature parity; record missing device validation and store review dependencies explicitly.

deadline_basis: User superseded 24-hour window with 7:31pm to 7:31am tomorrow on their Eastern clock; interpreted as America/New_York local time.

authorization.source: User explicitly granted full autonomy through the revised deadline.

experience_requirement: User requires a distinctive, polished and delightful experience with complete feature enhancements across every surface. Removing simulated claims is an interim repair, not fulfillment of the product scope. Industry leadership is an aspiration, not an unverified completion claim.
scope_coverage_rule: ALL existing and requested features, ALL suites, ALL public/authenticated/operator surfaces, and web/iOS/Android are in scope. Named examples and intermediate releases do not narrow the objective. Maintain a complete route/module/capability inventory and evidence per journey.

cost_and_execution_policy.requirement: Maximize verified output, minimize expense, no knowingly wasted builds or provider calls. User permits justified spending but no unlimited budget is inferred.
gates: Read relevant specialist skills and exact-version official documentation before unfamiliar tool changes
Run deterministic local checks using the remote build toolchain before consuming build credits
Batch reviewed changes into coherent releases
Inspect existing jobs before retrying; never duplicate an active build
No paid provider requests for probing or unverified placeholder workflows
Keep production load low during incidents
Record build identifiers, outcomes, and observable cost or credit usage
Report uncertainty and failures rather than promise zero mistakes

sector_specialist_delivery.requirement: Each profession receives specialist discovery and implementation covering its complete customer and operator journeys; business profiles become the organization's operating home. Rotate bounded specialist assignments across available concurrency, preserve shared architecture and native parity.
per_sector: Bookings, orders, memberships or intake as appropriate
Payments and reconciled receipts where authorized and configured
Relevant music, social and website integrations
AI assistance with permission boundaries and review
Unit, integration, browser and applicable device tests

expanded_innovation_scope: Original recommendation and workflow algorithms grounded in real data, evaluated against explicit outcomes
Technical SEO, structured data, crawlability and accurate information for search engines and agent retrieval; no guaranteed indexing or ranking
Richer maps, directions and navigation using available licensed providers and tested platform capabilities
Monitor provider and search changes; propose, test and review updates before deploying behavior changes
Organization operating homes with shared identity, data, brand, integrations and industry-specific tools
